content.claim: 7 alternating HfO2/SiO2 layers on silver reflect 97% of sunlight and give 40.1 W/m2 cooling power at ambient temperature
Machine learning has been used to optimize radiative-cooling coatings
content.source: Radiative cooling technology with artificial intelligence (review)

content.claim: Control: our simulator reproduces the Stanford design's 97% solar reflectance within 2 points
content.rationale: No design claim is trusted until the bench reproduces a published result

candidates.description: Skip the control and start the constrained search

content.why: Policy control_first: no design simulations before the control passes

content.reason: 97.7% vs 97% solar reflectance. Cooling power 11.8 vs published 40.1 W/m2: our sky model and film data give lower 8-13 um emission (0.39); documented as a known gap
content.next: Search cheap stacks against the benchmark target of 55 W/m2

content.claim: A 5-layer TiO2/SiO2 stack reaches 55 W/m2: TiO2's high index makes a strong solar mirror
content.rationale: High index contrast reflects sunlight with few layers; thick SiO2 emits near 9 um

content.claim: A 5-layer Al2O3/SiO2 stack reaches 55 W/m2: Al2O3 adds emission at 11-13 um
content.rationale: Al2O3 and SiO2 emit in different parts of the window and absorb little sunlight

content.why: Same cost; reflecting sunlight is the hardest part of daytime cooling

content.reason: 39.9 W/m2 < 55 target: emission is strong (0.76) but the stack absorbs 31 W/m2 of sunlight vs 23 for the control; TiO2 itself absorbs below 0.4 um
content.next: Replace TiO2 with Si3N4: transparent in the near-UV and emits at 10-12 um

content.claim: 4 layers of Si3N4/SiO2 on Ag reach 55 W/m2: Si3N4 emits at 10-12 um and SiO2 near 9 um, with little solar absorption
content.rationale: Keeps H2's window coverage while removing the near-UV absorber

content.why: V2 showed solar absorption is the bottleneck; H4 removes the absorber with one layer less

content.reason: 56.7 W/m2 >= 55 target with 4 cheap layers; absorbs 22 W/m2 of sunlight vs 31 for E2
content.next: Check robustness: thickness tolerances and a second sky model

content.request: Propose fabrication of the E3 design (4 layers Si3N4/SiO2 on Ag) for outdoor testing
